name: El final del paraíso
description: In this new era, Catalina, now head of the DEA in Colombia, has a new challenge: to track down a criminal organization that is trafficking a new synthetic drug. What she ignores is that her daughter is part of the Cartel that traffics them and that Yésica, her worst enemy, is infiltrated in the DEA.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: A Restaurant Serves As A Laboratory For Manufacturing Drugs. Catalina, Director Of The DEA In Colombia Cannot Believe That Her Daughter Is A Member Of The Babys Cartel, Which Produces The Dangerous XY4.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Mano Negra offers Yésica a cure in exchange for six important missions. Las Babies undertake an important operation. Hilda risks her life.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Valeria tricks her boss and asks for permission to leave the country. Las Babies set off for Las Vegas, but first Mariana calls her mother.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Mariana shows her skills and is ready to do anything to succeed as a drug trafficker. Catalina asks Agent Osman for help confronting cartel bosses.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: XY4, a synthetic drug, causes its first death in the U.S. Alarm bells go off for the DEA, and a new agent surprises Catalina.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: The bosses don't know how to escape while at the big boxing match. Catalina pursues Mariana and the unexpected occurs. Titi arrives in Las Vegas.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Mano Negra negotiates with the bosses to buy XY4 for $200 million; Catalina tries to derail the meeting. Albeiro receives major news about his health.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Aware that an agent is hiding in the duct, Mano Negra and the others at the meeting open fire. Rubens launches an operation to catch the narcos.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Mafiosos bid exorbitant amounts for XY4. Catalina is suffering and asks her daughter to kill her. Paola is kidnapped by a narco.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Catalina gets a call and must quickly decide if she wants to get her daughter back and save Valeria's life. Albeiro is upset about Jota's situation.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Catalina's decision endangers the DEA operation. Mano Negra openly threatens Titi. Albeiro reaches out to Catalina to share bad news.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Catalina evades her colleagues and meets Titi alone; he's ready to complete his mission. Mano Negra doesn't know where Titi has gone.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Catalina asks for Valeria and Mariana to be released and she will take their place. Just then, shots are fired; Catalina panics about her daughter.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Catalina is suffering because of her daughter, and desperation leads her to a drastic decision. Mariana is going through withdrawal.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: The authorities and the narcos are looking for Catalina, who would rather die than see Mariana become a victim of drugs.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Titi's associates will rescue Mariana and the DEA agent. Mano Negra wants Catalina's head. Yésica doesn't react; more tests are ordered.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Agent Rubens takes his most trusted men to capture Catalina. Meanwhile, Moncho and La Demonia are about to kill their biggest enemy.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: La Diabla fools everyone; when the nurse steps away, she gets in touch with Mano Negra. Catalina is cornered, unaware of an enemy closing in.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: Dr. Lugo gives Santiago, Jota and their group a shot to bring them back. It doesn't work, and they're sent to the morgue. Valeria is found out.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: Natalia sees Valeria hide. She knows something's going wrong and confronts her. La Diabla reacts strongly. Mano Negra and crew leave Las Vegas.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: Albeiro meets with Yésica, who asks him to do the impossible in exchange for HIV treatment. Catalina confirms that she'll be at the anti-drug summit.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: La Diabla demands more than a kiss from Albeiro. He finishes his next task, stunning Hilda. Salvatore doesn't know what to do with the woman he loves.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: While Catalina, Valeria, DEA members and Berrío meet, the narcos plan a massive attack to destroy their enemies.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: The car bomb takes out the doors at the anti-drug summit and Mano Negra celebrates. Julia surprises everyone with flowers and a bloody message.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: Titi's future is in danger. Mariana tells him some things and La Diabla finds out one of his secrets. Valeria uses her gifts to ensnare Berrío.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: Catalina is looking for Albeiro when she hears a sudden noise in the house and realizes someone is near. An unexpected encounter follows.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: Yésica calls Mano Negra and accuses Titi of having warned Catalina about the attack. There's no way out of this: someone must die.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: Titi and Pilar team up with Morón and Cardona's son and leave a gift for Mano Negra. Mariana begins to extract revenge from Jaramillo.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: Catalina already knows that the dead come back. The cartels keep working to control the market for XY4. Mano Negra clearly doesn't trust Dayana.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: Cardonita's men find La Demonia, and Titi suspects something's gone wrong. A thirst for vengeance means that more than one person may pay.

videos.title: Episode 31
videos.overview: Albeiro calls Catalina in order to show her that Yésica is alive. Calvo organizes a face-to-face meeting with Albeiro and Yésica.

videos.title: Episode 32
videos.overview: Pilar and Titi enjoy a passionate evening while Dayana tries to find the USB drive with the formula for XY4. Albeiro leaves a letter for Catalina.

videos.title: Episode 33
videos.overview: Titi is about to face his biggest enemy and knows that today might be his last. Mariana sneaks up on her ex and gets swept away by hatred.

videos.title: Episode 34
videos.overview: Delirious, Mariana imagines that Titi, already dead, is asking for his daughter. Afraid of losing her forever, Moncho tries to calm her down.

videos.title: Episode 35
videos.overview: Mano Negra is desperate without the drug formula. He loses his head and wants to kill. La Diabla decides to put an end to Morón and Cardonita.

videos.title: Episode 36
videos.overview: Titi is enjoying being presumed dead. Disguised, Dayana warns Mariana not to go to Titi's funeral, but Mariana confronts her.

videos.title: Episode 37
videos.overview: Catalina wants to see the body and is impressed as she nears the casket. When she looks up, she sees someone else who is suffering from the death.

videos.title: Episode 38
videos.overview: Leticia arrives at Berrío's event and confirms that his spouse is her daughter Carla. Lucrecia follows her to try to obtain her testimony.

videos.title: Episode 39
videos.overview: Dayana makes a move and gives Moncho an ultimatum. Afraid of Mano Negra, the Mexican narco knows that he needs to move quickly.

videos.title: Episode 40
videos.overview: Mano Negra goes over the details with Santos regarding a plan to kill Berrío. Valeria launches her plan. Lucrecia needs to talk to Catalina soon.

videos.title: Episode 41
videos.overview: Valeria does her duty and speaks with Mano Negra, and Lucrecia continues to spy on her. Berrío's assistant thinks he's similar to someone she knows.

videos.title: Episode 42
videos.overview: The debate is here and no one knows what to do when Berrío loses control. Valeria savors the moment, and asks her colleagues to stand down.

videos.title: Episode 43
videos.overview: Valeria has to act quickly. The DEA thinks that a mole put something in Alfonso's drink. Catalina makes a firm decision.

videos.title: Episode 44
videos.overview: Albeiro is stuck because he doesn't want to strike Jota, and Yésica threatens to kill Hilda. The two fighters know that time is running out.

videos.title: Episode 45
videos.overview: Mariana's hatred knows no bounds. Now she's kidnapped two families and is mistreating them. La Demonia wants to kill them like they did her mother.

videos.title: Episode 46
videos.overview: Hilda has an unexpected guest. Daniel and Simón meet the person who knows Mano Negra's biggest secrets. Cardonita goes to collect on an old debt.

videos.title: Episode 47
videos.overview: Mano Negra doesn't want to watch fights anymore. He wants something darker, and he has a candidate in mind. The scientist likes what he's hearing.

videos.title: Episode 48
videos.overview: Valeria gets a call that could change her future. La Diabla is surprised by her boss's new contact. Mano Negra launches the Phoenix plan.

videos.title: Episode 49
videos.overview: La Demonia has La Diabla in a corner, and La Diabla doesn't know what to do. Valeria is speechless and she needs to find her best weapon.

videos.title: Episode 50
videos.overview: La Diabla orders someone killed and has to deal with Albeiro, who declines to fight after Hilda told him that his daughter may have died.

videos.title: Episode 51
videos.overview: Berrío knows his life is in danger. He asks his girlfriend to come see him as soon as possible. Lucrecia is worried about what could happen.

videos.title: Episode 52
videos.overview: La Diabla goes wild after receiving a video from Mano Negra and pulls out her gun. Calvo tries to calm his boss down.

videos.title: Episode 53
videos.overview: The new and the old guard both suffer. Each gang is hit hard. Mano Negra is ready to do something insane. Titi is trapped with no way out.

videos.title: Episode 54
videos.overview: Calvo is en route to murder his own son. La Diabla's henchman is brought down and shares secrets with Albeiro.

videos.title: Episode 55
videos.overview: Desperate, Mariana wants to flee Mexico as soon as possible, now that her brother and her daughter are in danger. Mano Negra is hungry for revenge.

videos.title: Episode 56
videos.overview: Catalina is suffering because of her family. A rescue operation begins, but what she finds at the site where they were kept captive might be too much.

videos.title: Episode 57
videos.overview: Titi shares an important secret and offers up a new plan to kill La Diabla. Mano Negra has information needed to kill the traitors.

videos.title: Episode 58
videos.overview: Focused on new projects, Mano Negra asks his ally La Diabla to rescue his son. Santos prepares to execute Mariana and Moncho.

videos.title: Episode 59
videos.overview: Catalina invites a trusted ex-agent to an urgent meeting. Valeria accompanies Berrío to an event for the end of the campaign.

videos.title: Episode 60
videos.overview: Mano Negra wakes up to find himself trapped in the worst-case scenario. Santiago has a surprise for Alexander.

videos.title: Episode 61
videos.overview: La Diabla gets an unexpected call that may make her life more complicated. Santiago tells Mano Negra that his life is over, but Mano Negra isn't sure.

videos.title: Episode 62
videos.overview: The DEA has located the secret fights, and Catalina's unit goes into action. When they get there, they're surprised by what they find.

videos.title: Episode 63
videos.overview: Mano Negra, who needs to keep the DEA from learning his secrets, gives Alex a mission: protect the business and get revenge on his enemies.

videos.title: Episode 64
videos.overview: The medical report says that Calvo is recovering and will be able to talk soon. Valeria tries to see him in person. It's a big day for Berrío's wife.

videos.title: Episode 65
videos.overview: En route to Alfonso Berrío's inauguration as president of Colombia, Catalina runs into the person she least expected to see.

videos.title: Episode 66
videos.overview: In hopes of showing his loyalty, Titi shares a big secret with Catalina, although he could still betray her. La Cuina and Cardonita savor the moment.

videos.title: Episode 67
videos.overview: Johana is in the middle of a tense scene at the airport. Titi and Catalina try to make a scene to trick La Cuina.

videos.title: Episode 68
videos.overview: Facing new enemies, Catalina needs to use everything in the book to save her granddaughter. La Cuina knows her sister is looking for her.

videos.title: Episode 69
videos.overview: Rubens gathers the DEA team and Catalina has to record a video. Cardonita and Pilar join La Reina in planning to kill Catalina and Titi.

videos.title: Episode 70
videos.overview: Catalina has lost a person she loved dearly; she then receives a message that twists the knife further. Valeria meets with her boss Rubens.

videos.title: Episode 71
videos.overview: Mano Negra's heir adds a friend to his team and gives him a mission. Sebastián is ready to show how he feels about Alex. La Diabla silences an enemy.

videos.title: Episode 72
videos.overview: Berrío realizes that the documents are fake, but needs more time to catch La Diabla. The president faints and Nelly calls the first lady right away.

videos.title: Episode 73
videos.overview: Sombra, along with Arturo, Albeiro and Jota, shoots his way in to save Santiago. At the hospital, Lucrecia confronts Valeria and asks her to confess.

videos.title: Episode 74
videos.overview: Vanessa, Natalia and Iván find proof that will let them unmask Yésica for all to see. Berrío calls Lucrecia, not knowing what his wife has done.

videos.title: Episode 75
videos.overview: La Cuina turns La Titica over to La Diabla, and Yésica asks that she be killed along with La Tonina. In Mano Negra's plane, Alex plots his revenge.

videos.title: Episode 76
videos.overview: Sebastián doesn't know what his boyfriend is up to, but he doesn't want him to strike a deal with his sister. Santiago, Titi and Albeiro face off.

videos.title: Episode 77
videos.overview: Valeria continues her plans; Albeiro doesn't want to hear anything bad about her and Catalina can't change his mind. Marcela brings bad news.

videos.title: Episode 78
videos.overview: Albeiro is shaken by his son's kidnapping. After meeting with Vanessa, Jota and Marcela, he tries to prove that Yésica and Valeria are one person.

videos.title: Episode 79
videos.overview: Valeria blames Titi for the campaign against her and asks Albeiro to distance himself. Alex meets with La Reina, Moncho and Mariana.

videos.title: Episode 80
videos.overview: Nelly tells her boss Valeria what she heard during Alfonso's call with the FBI. Yésica and her husband talk and tell each other the truth.

videos.title: Episode 81
videos.overview: Nelly tells her boss Valeria what she heard during Alfonso's call with the FBI. Yésica and her husband talk and tell each other the truth.

videos.title: Episode 82
videos.overview: Santiago and Titi face off. Mariana's father wants to avenge his son. The new Mano Negra sends Yadith to watch over Mariana.

videos.title: Episode 83
videos.overview: Albeiro and Titi prepare for battle. Valeria talks to Albeiro and makes it clear who the first lady is. Catalina plans to take down Yésica.

videos.title: Episode 84
videos.overview: Valeria wants the heads of those involved in the attack and uses the opportunity to add her enemies to the hit list. Catalina is surprised by Mariana.

videos.title: Episode 85
videos.overview: Johana escapes to kill Hilda. Amid a struggle, Salvatore's ex-employee pulls the trigger, causing chaos.

videos.title: Episode 86
videos.overview: Alone, Valeria meets with an enemy in person. La Diabla wants to show that she's invincible, although she doesn't know if she'll make it out alive.

videos.title: Episode 87
videos.overview: Albeiro and Titi release all of their pent-up hate and fear. La Diabla's team kicks off an operation to rescue the child held by La Cuina and Pilar.

videos.title: Episode 88
videos.overview: La Cuina, Tonina and Pilar fall into a trap. Catalina doesn't want to hand over her granddaughter because the future with Mariana is dark.

videos.title: Episode 89
videos.overview: Valeria goes to visit Albeiro in the hospital where Hilda recognizes her. Catalina Santana's mother has a simple request for a powerful woman.

videos.title: Episode 90
videos.overview: Catalina Santana goes into action to kidnap Yésica Beltrán. The ex-DEA boss plays her last card to take out La Diabla. It's the final battle.
